title: Keto Thai Chicken Skewers
description: A spicy and flavorful Thai-inspired dish, perfect for a keto diet. Marinate chicken in a mixture of zesty citrus and chili, then grill to perfection on skewers.
instructions: 2. In a large bowl, whisk together lime juice, chili flakes, ginger, garlic, and a pinch of salt.
3. Add the chicken pieces to the marinade and mix well to coat.
4. Thread the marinated chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
5. Brush the grill grates with coconut oil to prevent sticking.
6. Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and slightly charred.
7. Garnish with chopped green onions and serve immediately.
